articles.summary: SAN JUAN CAPISTRANO, Calif., Aug. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - The Ensign Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: ENSG), the parent company of the Ensign™ group of companies, which invest in and provide skilled nursing and senior living services, physical, occupational and speech therapies, other rehabilitative and healthcare services, and real estate, announced today that it has amended its existing revolving Credit Facility with commitments totaling $800 million and extended the maturity date to August 19, 2031. The amended Credit Facility amends the Company's previous revolving Credit Facility and provides enhanced liquidity and financial flexibility to support its ongoing growth strategy, including acquisitions, capital investments and other general purposes. "We are pleased to complete this financing with the strong support of our lending partners," said Barry Port, Chief Executive Officer. articles.title: The Ensign Group Increases Credit Facility to $800 Million and Extends Maturity
